description: Crosscheck: Single developer forum observation treated as directional signal rather than verified fact.
document: A user on the Hacker News discussion thread noted that DatabaseX latency spikes whenever queries exceed 50 concurrent connections.

expected.claim_text: DatabaseX experiences latency degradation under high concurrent connections.
